summary: Grants View All and Modify All on Account to the Sales User permission set.

components.name: Sales_User
components.reason: Bypasses the Private sharing model on Account for every holder.

findings.message: Modify All Records on Account (and View All, line 11) overrides the Private sharing model: every Sales User can read and edit every account.
findings.fix: Revert both flags to false. If a team needs wider access, use a sharing rule or a separate, narrowly assigned permission set, approved by the org owner.
